decision_conditions: Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><ul><li>Location/Block Plan, Existing/Proposed Floor and Elevation Plans entitled Drawing No: 2411/02 Rev. C;</li><li>Fire Strategy Statement submitted 17-01-2025;</li></ul>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

The flat roofed area of the single storey rear extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Two storey side to rear extension, Single storey rear extension, Alterations to roof to form enlarged rear dormer with Juliette balcony, Roof light in front roof slope,  Replacement window in first floor rear elevation, Replacement roof to front porch (Demolition of side extension and side dormer)
